blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for Westwood Plateau. It has no local notes, street boundaries, schools or listing feed yet; see the open items below.

Westwood Plateau, Coquitlam: 67 houses and 47 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 10 and 7 sold in the month. It is one of 23 communities the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures break out for Coquitlam.
Westwood Plateau homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Westwood Plateau, September 2026. Detached houses: 67 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 47 listed at month end and 7 sold in September, a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market).

The monthly write-ups singled out Westwood Plateau for detached houses in July (a buyers’ best bet).
Westwood Plateau share of Coquitlam listings and sales by month

In Westwood Plateau, its share of the houses listed in Coquitlam went from 13.7% in June to 15.8% in September and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 6.5% to 5.8%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

items.t: Westwood Plateau condos and townhomes for sale

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Westwood Plateau?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 67 houses and 47 condos and townhomes listed in Westwood Plateau. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Westwood Plateau a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market); condos and townhomes had 15% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Westwood Plateau from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 32 houses and 35 condos and townhomes sold in Westwood Plateau over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in June with 12 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 13 sold.

faq.q: How big is Westwood Plateau compared with the rest of Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Westwood Plateau held 15.8% of the 425 detached houses listed in Coquitlam and 5.8% of the 806 condos and townhomes listed in Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Westwood Plateau?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 58.8% of the 114 homes listed in Westwood Plateau and condos and townhomes made up 41.2%; of the 17 that sold, houses were 58.8% and condos and townhomes 41.2%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Westwood Plateau than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses rose from 61 to 67 (+9.8%) and condos and townhomes fell from 53 to 47 (−11.3%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
